Title: Additions to GitHub repository for Logic app connectors

Body.Content:
We have added new connectors in the GitHub Logic Apps Repository. The repository now includes:
  • RSS API app for getting data from RSS feeds, including a trigger and actions
  • Azure Event Hub connector for pushing events and getting notified when an event is published
  • Push to Azure Notifications Hubs
  • Azure Resource Manager access when triggered by Events or Alerts and for performing management actions on any Azure resources
  • Simple code expressions written in JavaScript or C# for your Logic app
  • Azure Queue connector for when triggered by and for pushing messages to Azure Queues
Please note that the API apps in the GitHub repository are supplied by the community and provided as-is. This means that we can also accept your submissions if you have API apps that you would like to share with the community. If you have questions regarding these new features or anything else, please head over to the Azure Logic Apps Forum.
